set off: We set off early in the morning to avoid the heavy traffic on the highway.
我们一大早就出发,以避开高速公路上的拥堵。
in one go: He was so thirsty that he drank the whole bottle of water in one go.
他渴极了,一口气喝光了整瓶水。
rock climbing: Rock climbing is exciting, but you must always check your equipment carefully.
攀岩很刺激,但你必须始终仔细检查装备。
catch up: She stayed late after class to catch up on the lessons she had missed.
她放学后留在教室很晚,以补上落下的功课。
call off: The football match was called off because of the heavy rain.
由于大雨,足球比赛被取消了。
thanks to: Thanks to his quick thinking, the little boy was saved from the fire.
多亏他反应快,小男孩才从火中获救。
health care: The government has promised to spend more money on health care for old people.
政府承诺在老年人医疗保健上投入更多资金。
once in a while: Once in a while, my family goes out for dinner instead of cooking at home.
偶尔,我们全家会出去吃饭,而不是在家做饭。
heat up: She heated up some soup for lunch because it was a cold day.
天气很冷,她热了一些汤当午餐。
laugh at: It is unkind to laugh at people who make mistakes when they speak a foreign language.
嘲笑说外语时出错的人是不厚道的。
try one's best: Don't worry about the exam result; what matters is that you tried your best.
别担心考试结果,重要的是你已经尽了最大努力。
Giotto di Bondone: Giotto di Bondone was a great Italian painter whose works changed the style of his time.
乔托是一位伟大的意大利画家,他的作品改变了那个时代的绘画风格。
the Renaissance: Many famous artists appeared in Italy during the Renaissance.
文艺复兴时期,许多著名艺术家在意大利涌现。
by coincidence: By coincidence, we chose the same hotel without telling each other.
巧合的是,我们没有互相商量就选择了同一家酒店。
a great deal: She knows a great deal about Chinese history and often shares it with us.
她对中国历史了解很多,经常和我们分享。
on the other hand: The plan is cheap; on the other hand, it will take a lot of time.
这个方案很省钱;另一方面,它要花很多时间。
Mona Lisa: Thousands of visitors go to the Louvre every year to see the Mona Lisa.
每年成千上万的游客去卢浮宫看《蒙娜丽莎》。
Leonardo da Vinci: Leonardo da Vinci was not only a painter but also a scientist and an inventor.
列奥纳多·达·芬奇不仅是画家,还是科学家和发明家。
in the flesh: I had only seen her in photos before, but last night I met her in the flesh.
以前我只在照片里见过她,但昨晚我见到了她本人。
Guggenheim Museum: The Guggenheim Museum in New York attracts visitors with its unusual round building.
纽约古根海姆博物馆以其独特的圆形建筑吸引着游客。
appeal to: This kind of music doesn't appeal to me, but my brother loves it.
这种音乐对我没有吸引力,但我哥哥很喜欢。
nursery rhyme: The little girl fell asleep while her mother was singing a nursery rhyme to her.
小女孩在妈妈给她唱童谣时睡着了。
take it easy: Take it easy and don't work too hard, or you will make yourself ill.
放松点,别太用功,不然你会累病的。
run out of: We ran out of paper, so I had to go to the shop to buy some more.
我们的纸用完了,所以我只好去商店再买一些。
be made up of: The class is made up of twenty boys and fifteen girls.
这个班由二十名男生和十五名女生组成。
in particular: I love all kinds of fruit, and mangoes in particular.
各种水果我都喜欢,尤其是芒果。
let out: The students let out a cheer when the teacher announced the good news.
当老师宣布这个好消息时,学生们发出一阵欢呼。
due to: The flight was delayed for two hours due to the thick fog.
由于大雾,航班延误了两个小时。
addicted to: He used to be addicted to computer games and often stayed up very late.
他曾经沉迷于电脑游戏,常常熬夜到很晚。
accustomed to: After a few weeks in the new city, she got accustomed to the spicy food there.
在新城市住了几周后,她习惯了那里的辣味食物。
decide on: After comparing several hotels, we finally decided on the one near the beach.
比较了几家酒店后,我们最终选定了海滩附近的那家。
feel like: I don't feel like cooking tonight; let's eat out instead.
今晚我不想做饭,我们出去吃吧。
feel like doing: It is such a lovely day that I feel like taking a walk by the river.
天气这么好,我想去河边散散步。
chewing gum: Please throw away your chewing gum in the bin instead of sticking it under the desk.
请把口香糖扔进垃圾桶,不要粘在桌子底下。
in spite of: In spite of the cold weather, the workers kept on building the bridge.
尽管天气寒冷,工人们仍坚持修建大桥。
take a risk: Sometimes you have to take a risk if you really want to succeed.
有时候,如果你真想成功,就得冒一次险。
at risk: Many wild animals are at risk because their homes are being destroyed.
许多野生动物正处于危险之中,因为它们的家园正在被破坏。
come about: Nobody knows exactly how the change in the plan came about.
没有人确切知道计划中的变更是怎么发生的。
subscribe to: I don't subscribe to the idea that money can bring people true happiness.
我不赞成金钱能给人带来真正幸福的观点。
quantities of: Quantities of rubbish were left on the beach after the holiday.
假期过后,海滩上留下了大量垃圾。
